subject: How can I change the title according to the result in qplot

messages.author: fd010b44b4f0487b
messages.subject: How can I change the title according to the result in qplot
parts:
I made a function that conduct a linear regression analysis, draw a
scatter plot, and add a regression line through qplot.
Now, I want to put title that " the slope is xx" in that plot.
Since the slope is keep changing, xx should be changed every time.
How can I do that?

This is my code for the function.

graph <- function(data) {
g <- lm(data$offspring ~data$parent)
coef <- summary(g)$coefficient[,1]
qplot(parent, offspring, data = data, colour = nfam, main = "slope =
coef[2] # this part should be changed") +geom_abline(intercept =
coef[1] , slope= coef[2])
}

Thanks,

messages.author: f53f4ca2c430170d
messages.subject: Re: How can I change the title according to the result in qplot
parts: See your code below, something like that will work. K

On 03/10/10 10:43, Sophia wrote:
> I made a function that conduct a linear regression analysis, draw a
> scatter plot, and add a regression line through qplot.
> Now, I want to put title that " the slope is xx" in that plot.
> Since the slope is keep changing, xx should be changed every time.
> How can I do that?
>
> This is my code for the function.
>

cf <- coef(g)
titleText <- paste("slope = ", cf[2], sep = '')
qplot(parent, offspring, data = data, colour = nfam, main = titleText)
